records.name: Adze of Annam
records.why: Bonus damage, force rider and the two cast uses are carried by the activities; double damage to objects is marginal.

records.name: Crown of the Wrath Bringer
records.why: Spending a Hit Die on a hit for extra psychic damage is a use-time choice; data lacks it (only the fear cast is present).

records.name: Delver's Claws
records.why: Burrow/blindsight effects exist, but the rune's Hit Die spend with Con healing is a use-time choice that the data lacks.

records.name: Elven Thrower
records.why: Extra damage only on ranged hits, larger vs Giants, plus return to hand: restricted variants exist but nothing applies them automatically.

records.name: Glowrune Pigment
records.why: Data lacks the rune effects (temp HP, advantage on saves, prone immunity, darkvision, one rune at a time).

records.name: Harp of Gilded Plenty
records.why: Charges and the cast activities are present; the check floor and sentience are non-combat.

records.name: Helm of Perfect Potential
records.why: Bolt activity has no damage and lacks the damage type choice; charge-cost spellcasting is partial.

records.name: Horizon Puzzle Cube
records.why: Puzzle and portal to a demiplane; nothing acts in combat.

records.name: Lash of Immolation
records.why: Critical hit restrains the target, and a reaction raises the extra fire die; data lacks both.

records.name: Longbow of the Healing Hearth
records.why: Curative arrow replaces an attack, once per turn, with a Hit Die choice and Wis bonus; data lacks it.

records.name: Mistral Mantle
records.why: Save triggered by moving next to a creature, once per turn, with prone on a fail; data has a half-damage save instead.

records.name: Nimbus Coronet
records.why: Data lacks the cloud form (fly speed, physical resistance, end on incapacitation) and the short teleport.

records.name: Orb of Skoraeus
records.why: Effects carry the concentration bonus and darkvision; charges for components are a resource on the item.

records.name: Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power, Carnelian Triceratops
Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power, Jasper Tyrannosaurus Rex
records.why: Summon is missing from data, and a roll of 1 on each command makes the creature hostile.

records.name: Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power, Kyanite Pteranodon
Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power, Pyrite Plesiosaurus
Reaper's Scream
records.why: Natural 20 grants temp HP and attackers take necrotic damage while they last; rune save only partly set up.

records.name: Ring of Amity
records.why: Reaction turns an ally's hit into a critical, and healing is shared with the bonded creature; data lacks both.

records.name: Sanctum Amulet
records.why: Resistance is carried by an effect, but the reaction that leaves a creature at 1 HP instead of 0 is missing.

records.name: Shield of the Blazing Dreadnought
records.why: Data lacks the active state (fire immunity, bash replacing an attack once per turn, condition cleanse).

records.name: Staff of the Rooted Hills
records.why: Restraint on the first hit each turn after a Str save; data has a save and effect but no first-hit limit.

records.name: Stonebreaker's Breastplate
records.why: Resistances and prone immunity are effects and the wall cast has uses; concentration advantage is minor.

records.name: Thunderbuss
records.why: Rune burst save and damage exist, but the failed-save rider (no reactions until end of next turn) and thunder swap are missing.

records.name: War Horn of Valor
records.why: Data lacks ending frightened, advantage vs fear until next turn, and the +1 AC to chosen creatures in range.

records.name: Wayfarer's Boots
records.why: Walk speed and Survival advantage are effects; expeditious retreat is a cast with a limited-use rune.

records.name: Wyrmreaver Gauntlets
records.why: Data lacks extra unarmed force damage, 30 ft reach and prone on opportunity attack hits, and the chosen resistance; the save is misapplied.
